question: Should CodexBar reject quotio’s anonymous PostHog telemetry or sponsor a separate telemetry proposal with explicit privacy and CI-secret safeguards?
rationale: Source inspection can identify the telemetry and secret-handling implications, but it cannot determine whether maintainers intend to add data collection to CodexBar.

options.title: Reject telemetry adoption
options.body: Record the telemetry and CI-secret commits as intentionally inapplicable, with the badge, version, and screenshot changes treated as quotio-specific maintenance.

options.title: Sponsor a telemetry proposal
options.body: Require a focused proposal covering consent, disclosure, collected fields, retention, opt-out behavior, data minimization, secret permissions, and real runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Reject telemetry adoption
recommendation.body: Record the telemetry and CI-secret commits as intentionally inapplicable, with the badge, version, and screenshot changes treated as quotio-specific maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes repository-level product and data-collection policy, making the repository owner the best available decision owner.
